scenarios.title: Released result correction preserves the original
given: a released result with a reviewer signature
when: an authorized correction supplies a reason and successor revision
then: the original remains visible
the successor links to the original
downstream consumers receive the correction event
scenarios.failure_twin: a correction omits its reason or reviewer authority
scenarios.recovery: route the correction to accountable review with its original evidence intact

scenarios.title: Ambiguous vendor write reconciles before resubmission
given: a stable request identity and canonical content digest
when: the vendor commits and the client receives a timeout
then: readback locates one matching effect
the request resolves as converged
scenarios.failure_twin: changed content reuses the stable request identity
scenarios.recovery: classify the collision and preserve both content digests for review

scenarios.title: Concurrent custody transfer reloads current position
given: a specimen at a versioned source location
when: a transfer proposes an earlier version
then: the current position remains authoritative
the requester receives the current revision
scenarios.failure_twin: two transfers share the same expected revision
scenarios.recovery: reload current custody and construct a new attributable transfer

scenarios.title: Partial instrument artifact enters quarantine
given: an expected artifact identity and transfer manifest
when: received bytes produce a divergent content digest
then: the artifact enters quarantine
the original bytes and digest remain linked
a recovery owner is assigned
scenarios.failure_twin: a replay carries the same identity and changed bytes
scenarios.recovery: request a complete transfer and reconcile against the preserved receipt

scenarios.title: Sapio specimen graph matches scientific readback
given: an approved tenant and SDK compatibility tuple
a synthetic specimen aliquot and plate graph
then: independent readback preserves identity and every relationship
the UI-facing plate semantics match the graph
scenarios.failure_twin: records exist while the plate relationship remains semantically incomplete
scenarios.recovery: retain the fixture namespace and route the mapping to compatibility review

scenarios.title: Benchling duplicate and late events converge
given: a verified webhook envelope and durable inbox
when: duplicate events arrive after a newer event
then: one refresh job remains active
authoritative API state drives reconciliation
scenarios.failure_twin: an event payload omits properties required for scientific meaning
scenarios.recovery: retrieve the current resource and record the event as a work signal

scenarios.title: LabKey validates and commits an atomic batch
given: a staging server with versioned modules and restricted API identity
when: validate-only succeeds and the batch commits with an audit reason
then: normalized readback matches canonical content
audit and artifact digests reconcile
scenarios.failure_twin: one command in the batch carries an invalid value
scenarios.recovery: preserve zero committed effects and return the validation evidence

scenarios.title: Representative migration preserves meaning
given: a frozen source inventory and representative corpus
when: snapshot load and delta catch-up complete
then: identity content relationships audit signatures and artifacts reach approved parity
exceptions carry accountable disposition
scenarios.failure_twin: an attachment digest or signature relationship diverges
scenarios.recovery: close the cutover gate and resume from the last accepted checkpoint

scenarios.title: Second operator completes clean restore
given: base backup journals artifacts configuration and identity dependencies
when: an alternate trained operator restores into a clean environment
then: acceptance probes pass within objectives
records and evidence remain reconstructable
scenarios.failure_twin: the newest backup or a journal segment is unavailable
scenarios.recovery: select the newest restore-proven recovery point and record the observed RPO

scenarios.title: Revoked identity loses tenant access within target
given: a tenant-scoped service identity and approved revocation objective
then: subsequent requests receive the approved authorization response
audit evidence records the decision and time
scenarios.failure_twin: a cached credential remains effective beyond the objective
scenarios.recovery: expire the cache path and verify each affected authorization surface

scenarios.title: Telemetry failure preserves service and evidence accounting
given: a bounded queue and a defined good-event denominator
then: service behavior follows the resilience policy
queued and dropped events remain measurable
an actionable alert reaches the owner
scenarios.recovery: route telemetry through the privacy-preserving fallback and record the affected window

scenarios.title: Accountable release records distinct decisions
given: complete bounded receipts and a named intended-use profile
when: scientific Quality Regulatory Security Operations and business reviews complete
then: each role records its decision scope and meaning
residual risks and requalification triggers remain visible
scenarios.recovery: preserve the release as qualification-ready and route the open domain to its named owner
